PLAY-REC-D266-TROLLS-R1-001
Player exact instruction: "Mara move the cart back and away until it’s safe. Cirren Fenar, hind with me on the side." DM interpreted "hind" contextually as "hide"; V and Fenar hide at south roadside trees, Cirren follows, Mara begins attempting to evacuate coach/horses. Genuinely executed Python secrets rolls Round1 initiative: V d20 18+4=22; Fenar 20+2=22; Troll A 14+1=15; Cirren 7+2=9; Mara 8+0=8 (NPC provisional +0); Troll B 6+1=7. Stealth: V 9+10=19; Fenar 20+5=25; Cirren 4+2=6. No surprise; no dice fudged or rerolled. No injury/resource expenditure/horse loss. Two trolls each Dash 60ft, no attacks.

PLAY-REC-D266-TROLLS-R2-001
Player order: "Quick toss the closest creature (if i have sneak attack). Then hold action to attack when cirren or fenar are in melee (if I have sneak attack) Else attack twice." Fenar acts first at tied init22, closes to A(35,-21), BA Rage3->2, Reckless attacks +8 vsAC15: greataxe adv(16,1)=24, d12(7)+7=14; claw adv(19,5)=27, d6(4)+7=11; extra claw adv(14,20)=critical, 2d6(1,6)+7=14; total39. V moves from(0,-35) to(26,-35) within20ft A, BA Quick Toss spends 1 superiority die4->3, d20(9)+9=18 hit AC15, damage dart d4(4)+DEX4+superiority d8(1)+Sneak2d6(1,5)=15. A HP84->30, regenerates10 at its turn start->40. A bites raging Fenar: adv(11,10)+7=18 vsAC14, damage1d6(1)+4=5 halves2. V uses Readied action reaction triggering after troll attacks Fenar in melee, thrown physical dart d20(15)+9=24 vsAC15 hit, d4(4)+DEX4+Sneak2d6(4,1)=13 damage (off-turn SA legal), A HP40->27. A claws advantage vs Reckless Fenar: adv(19,1)+7=26 damage2d6(1,5)+4=10 halves5; adv(10,18)+7=25 damage2d6(2,3)+4=9 halves4. Cirren init9 BA Spiritual Weapon 2nd-level spell L2 2->1, attack d20(18)+8=26 vsAC15, damage1d8(5)+WIS5=10, A HP27->17. Cirren action Toll the Dead injured A, save d20(17)-1=16 meets DC16, no damage. Mara init8 continues preparing horse harness; coach NOT moved. B moves from(61,-17) to(38,-19), adjacent Fenar, multiattacks at advantage: bite adv(17,10)+7=24, d6(2)+4=6 halves3; claw adv(19,20)=critical, 4d6(5,5,4,5)+4=23 halves11; last claw adv(1,1)+7=8 misses. Fenar HP58->33 from 25 damage total; Rage active, Reckless vulnerability until her next turn. Troll A HP17, B HP84, neither has taken fire/acid. V HP48, Cirren HP49, horses healthy, coach intact. Round2 ended, R3 V action unchosen. All die faces genuinely executed via Python secrets for this round.

PLAY-REC-D266-TROLLS-R2-REST-CORRECTION-001
Round2 wilderness roadside troll combat caused actual Fenar damage 58/59->33/59 and expenditure of adventuring limited resources (Fenar Rage3/4->2/4, V Superiority4/4->3/4, Cirren 2nd-level slots2/3->1/3). Campaign RULES combat-recovery: wilderness Long Rest progress is interrupted/reset by damage or significant limited-resource expenditure, so precombat weighted progress2/6 resets to0/6 during Round2. This does not create another night, rest, event roll or restore any resources. This is an omitted dependent consequence of accepted Round2 actions; original event remains unaltered and fully evidenced by PLAY-REC-D266-TROLLS-R2-001.

PLAY-REC-D266-TROLLS-R3-001
Player: "same thing" repeats prior authorized V bonus-action Quick Toss into closest viable conscious troll (Sneak Attack while Fenar in melee), then action Ready a physical dart for when a troll attacks Cirren or Fenar in melee, using one reaction if triggered. Player separately directs use of updated GitHub combat hot path and small recovery write. Genuine Python secrets d20/damage rolls, no fudging. Shared initiative V/Fenar22 (Fenar acts first): Fenar moves no farther, continues active Rage, Reckless Attack; greataxe vs Troll A advantage d20(11,20) natural20 +8 critical, 2d12(1,7)+STR5+Rage2=15, A17->2; beast claw vs A adv(15,9)+8=23 hit, 1d6(1)+7=8, A2->0 and collapses; extra claw vs B adv(11,16)+8=24, 1d6(2)+7=9, B84->75; BA Longtooth Shift2->1, tempHP0->6, fang vs B adv(6,11)+8=19, 1d6(1)+7=8, B75->67. V moves ~25ft from(26,-35) to(28,-10) to obtain clear non-adjacent dart line (A about16ft, B about13ft). V Quick Toss BA targets nearest conscious B while A down, normal range20ft, d20(13)+9=22 vs AC15 hit; d4(3)+DEX4+Superiority d8(3)+Sneak2d6(3,5)=18, B67->49; superiority3->2/4. V action Ready another normal untracked dart for enemy melee attack against companion; trigger A's bite attack on Fenar. Troll A start of turn regeneration10 at0HP (no fire/acid), returns at10 HP and stands using half its movement, attacks Fenar Reckless-exposed: bite adv d20(13,7) high13+7=20 vsAC14, 1d6(1)+4=5 halves to2; V readied reaction dart at A d20(3)+9=12 MISS (no damage or Sneak Attack), reaction spent. A claw1 adv(13,1)+7=20 vsAC14 hit, 2d6(2,4)+4=10 halves5; claw2 adv(14,18)+7=25 hit, 2d6(5,6)+4=15 halves7. Fenar takes total14; tempHP6 absorbs first6, true HP33->25. Cirren init9 moves to(34,-20) adjacent B to draw fire; BA Healing Word Fenar, 1st level slot3->2/4, d4(2)+WIS5=7 HP25->32; action Toll the Dead at wounded B DC16 Wis; B save d20(8)-1=7 fails, damage2d12(5,1)=6 necrotic, B49->43. Cirren's Spiritual Weapon from R2 remains active, cannot strike with it in R3 due Healing Word competing BA. Mara init8 still harnessing/handling frightened coach horses; no completed evacuation. Troll B init7 multiattack Fenar (she used Reckless): bite adv(5,12) +7=19 hit, d6(4)+4=8 halved4 Fenar32->28; claw1 adv(1,7)+7=14 hit vsAC14, 2d6(6,1)+4=11 halves5, Fenar28->23; claw2 adv(1,4)+7=11 misses. All 4 horses healthy, coach stationary; no fire/acid inflicted, so A/B continue eligible to regenerate at next start of own turns. No extra V decision, no additional rest or encounter RNG.

PLAY-REC-D266-TROLLS-R3-B-REGEN-CORR-001
Mechanical correction to PLAY-REC-D266-TROLLS-R3-001, not new roll, extra action, resource, or turn: 2014 standard Troll B Regeneration10 applies at START of its own Round3 turn because it took no fire or acid damage. After Fenar17, V Quick Toss18, and Cirren Toll6, Troll B had HP43/84. On initiative7 before its already recorded bite/two claws, Troll B therefore regained exactly10 to HP53/84. The previous round3 event correctly recorded all damage, dice and action outcomes but omitted B's own-start +10 regeneration. R4 begins Troll B HP53/84, not43. Troll A10/84 remains correct.

PLAY-REC-D266-TROLLS-R4-001
Player command: 'Fire or acid! Same thing.' Interpreted as explicit spoken fire/acid call to companions and repeat V's Round3 Quick Toss then Ready reaction when troll attacks melee ally, conditional Sneak Attack. No fire/acid damage was actually inflicted this round. Genuine secrets RNG, no fudging: Shared initiative22 Fenar acts first (active Rage+Shift, Reckless). Greataxe Troll A advantage(9,9)+8=17 vs AC15 hit 1d12(9)+7=16, A10->0. Claw Troll B adv(12,19)+8=27 hit d6(5)+7=12, B53->41. Extra claw B adv(17,16)+8=25 hit d6(1)+7=8, B41->33. Shifted fang BA B adv(14,4)+8=22 hit d6(5)+7=12, B33->21. V BA Quick Toss against closest conscious B from(28,-10), within normal 20ft, ally Fenar adjacent grants Sneak Attack: attack d20(12)+9=21 hit AC15, d4(1)+DEX4+superiority d8(7)+SA2d6(6,5)=23 B21->0; superiority2->1 of4. V action Ready mundane untracked dart against troll when it attacks Fenar or Cirren in melee. Troll A initiative15 begins at0 HP with no fire/acid, Regeneration +10 to10, stands and bites Reckless Fenar advantage(3,12)+7=19 vs AC14 hit d6(6)+4=10 physical, Rage halves5, Fenar23->18. V reaction after bite d20(14)+9=23 vsAC15 hit, dart d4(4)+DEX4+Sneak2d6(5,2)=15, A10->0, becomes incapacitated and cannot complete its remaining two claws. Cirren initiative9 (from34,-20) BA Healing Word Fenar first-level slot2->1/4, d4(1)+WIS5=6, Fenar18->24. Then action Dash to fire(+8,+3) ~35ft away, safely leaving both downed trolls (no OA), takes ordinary burning firebrand via object interaction; no fire attack this turn. Cirren maintains existing nonconcentration Spiritual Weapon nearby; cannot bonus attack with it due Healing Word BA. Mara init8 still preparing frightened horses/coach escape, no departure yet. Troll B init7 starts at0 HP with no fire/acid, Regeneration +10->10, stands and multiattacks Fenar with advantage due Reckless: bite adv(6,11)+7=18 hit d6(1)+4=5/2=2 damage, Fenar24->22; claw1 adv(18,14)+7=25 hit 2d6(3,3)+4=10/2=5, Fenar22->17; claw2 adv(17,19)+7=26 hit 2d6(3,1)+4=8/2=4, Fenar17->13. No damage to V/Cirren/coach/horses. End Round4 Troll A0/84 (alive/regenerates next turn), Troll B10/84 (alive/regenerates next turn), Fenar HP13/59 Raging Shifted, V HP48/48, Cirren HP49/51 with firebrand. No long rest progression, no consumption or extra encounter roll.

PLAY-REC-D266-TROLLS-R5-001
Player command: "same thing. Emphasize to the others to burn them." V repeats Quick Toss vs closest active Troll B with Sneak Attack (Fenar adjacent B at V's initiative) and Readied mundane dart against troll attacks on Cirren/Fenar only if Sneak Attack eligible; shouts fire/acid to companions. All DICE GENUINELY EXECUTED using Python secrets; no fudges. INITIATIVE 22: V acts first, BA Quick Toss at Troll B (HP10): d20 natural20+9=29 critical AC15. Damage 2d4(3,2)+DEX4+2d8 superiority(4,4)+4d6 Sneak(2,3,2,4)=28; B10->0 (regeneration still available), V superiority1->0/4. Action Ready physical standard dart for troll attack on Fenar/Cirren when Sneak Attack eligible; no reaction actually triggered. Fenar independently responds to fire call, as both Troll A and B currently at0 HP cannot make opportunity attacks: leaves(35,-21), moves ~36ft to cooking fire(8,+3), uses action to select/ignite a burning length of wood; Rage and Shift remain active under adopted 10-minute no-inactivity Rage rule, HP13 unchanged; no fire contact with troll. Troll A INIT15 HP0 begins turn: Regeneration +10 to10 since no acid/fire, stands using half movement and moves close to V at approx(31,-14); Multiattacks V AC19: bite d20(4)+7=11 misses, claw1 d20(16)+7=23 hits damage2d6(2,2)+4=8, claw2 d20(17)+7=24 hits damage2d6(5,4)+4=13. V HP48->27. Since A attacked V, not Fenar/Cirren, V's readied trigger NOT met; no reaction. Cirren INIT9 moves ~24-28ft from fire to(25,-10) within melee reach of Troll A, keeps burning brand; BA directs existing Spiritual Weapon at A d20(5)+8=13 miss, no damage or slot cost, still active; action makes burning-torch melee attack at A d20 natural1, automatic miss regardless unverified STR modifier; NO fire damage or condition, torch still burning. Mara INIT8 tends frightened healthy horses and starts leading them cautiously northward from(-15,+35) by a few feet; coach remains stationary/unhitched, horses not yet out of danger. Troll B INIT7 at0 HP Regeneration +10 to10 (no fire/acid), stands using15ft movement, then Dashes around eastern flank to approx(25,+5), pursuing coach/horse scent, no attack. Adjacent Large trolls cannot overlap; B takes clear eastern path around A, not through occupied squares. End Round5: V HP27/48 at(28,-10), Superiority0/4, reaction unused (ready expires at next V turn), Fenar HP13/59 near fire(8,+3) raging, shifted and holding burning branch; Cirren HP49/51 at(25,-10) with burning brand, Spiritual Weapon still active; Troll A10/84 at(31,-14), B10/84 at(25,+5), both alive with regeneration active and no fire/acid damage. Coach intact stationary; all four horses healthy and moving slightly north with Mara. Wilderness Long Rest0/6, no new day/feed/rest/encounter.

PLAY-REC-D266-TROLLS-R6-001
Player: 'Action surge. Same thing.' With Superiority0, Quick Toss unavailable; V authorized normal Attack with Psychic Blade then Action Surge to Ready a mundane dart against troll attacks on Fenar/Cirren. All new d20/damage rolled genuinely with Python secrets (no fabrication). R6 shared initiative22: Fenar moves from fire(8,3) to(31,-9), Reckless torch attack vs A AC15 advantage(16,4)+STR5=21 hit, deals 1 FIRE A HP10->9; Beast Claw advantage(9,16)+8=24 hit d6(6)+7=13 A9->0; moves remaining 12ft to(25,0) adjacent B, extra claw advantage(3,3)+8=11 miss; shifted fang BA advantage(8,7)+8=16 hit d6(4)+7=11 B10->0. V moves from(28,-10) to(20,+5) within5ft unconscious B, Attack action Psychic Blade melee advantage(14,11)+7=21 hit, automatic critical due unconscious within5ft, damage 2d6(6,4)+DEX4+4d6 Sneak(3,2,6,6)=31 psychic (B remains at0, no fire/acid), moves to(15,-5) away from both downed foes. V Action Surge1->0 grants extra action Ready physical dart after enemy attacks Fenar/Cirren. A initiative15 begins turn at0 with fire damage since last turn: Regeneration suppressed, A DIES (no attacks). Cirren initiative9 moves near B(20,+5), BA Healing Word to Fenar 1st slot1->0, d4(4)+WIS5=9 Fenar HP13->22; action improvised burning torch attack against prone/unconscious B within5ft with advantage d20(6,8), fails AC15 (no fire); Spiritual Weapon remains active but no BA strike due Healing Word. Mara initiative8 leads healthy horses another ~20ft north to(-15,+60), coach(0,+15) remains stationary. B initiative7 at0 without fire/acid regenerates +10 to10, stands and multiattacks Reckless Fenar: bite advantage(5,19)+7=26 vsAC14 hit d6(6)+4=10 physical Rage halves5 Fenar22->17. V Readied dart reaction from(15,-5) ~14ft at B, Fenar adjacent B gives Sneak Attack; d20(12)+9=21 vsAC15 hit, damage d4(3)+DEX4+2d6 Sneak(4,5)=16, B10->0, stopping remaining claws. No further rolls or attacks this round; no fire damage against B, remains regenerating alive at0. End R6 tactical outcome stable.

PLAY-REC-D266-TROLLS-R7-END-001
Player exact instruction: 'Hide, hold for fire, then attack.' Continuing D266 troll encounter at start Round7. V Cunning Action bonus-action Hide, moves 29ft from (15,-5) to a concealing thick southern treeline trunk approx(25,-32); genuine Python secrets Stealth d20 FACE9+10=19 vs passive troll12 (troll B already at0 and incapacitated); V is concealed until attack. V action Ready an ordinary house-unlimited physical dart to attack when fire actually damages the last troll. Fenar (same initiative22, acting after V) still Raging/Shifted, at(25,0) adjacent to prone/down Troll B HP0/84. She uses action to thrust already held lit firebrand at Troll B: genuine advantage d20 FACES3,13, high13 + established torch melee attack+5=18 vs AC15 HIT; standard torch deals1 FIRE damage (B stays0/84) and suppresses its next start-of-turn Regeneration. This triggers V's Ready reaction from approx37ft (dart long range>20, target prone and V hidden: 2014 advantage and disadvantage cancel => standard single d20). Genuine d20 FACE4+ ranged dart modifier9=13 vsAC15 MISS; no dart/sneak damage; V no longer hidden due attack. V has Superiority0/4, ActionSurge0/1; no limited V resources spent in Round7. Troll B remains0 until initiative7, then cannot Regenerate because it took fire since previous turn; per standard 2014 MM Troll dies at start of own turn at0 without regeneration. Troll A already died Round6. Cirren/Mara have no needed attacks/spell expenditures; all four horses healthy, coach stationary, Mara still handling horses to the north of coach. Combat ENDS during Round7, no additional foes, loot, spell, rest, XP award, time skip, or resource refresh. Party V27/48, Fenar17/59, Cirren49/51. LongRest0/6. Active Rage/Shift/Spiritual Weapon continue only through remaining ordinary durations until an actual time lapse; no premature refresh.

PLAY-REC-D266-TROLLS-AFTERMATH-001
Player exact instruction after closing two-troll encounter: "Let’s check out the scene. Check if there anything to loot or if there’s more danger." Party conducts reasonable careful 15-minute exploration of immediate wayside camp, corpses, and southern approach, no extra encounter. Actual executed Python secrets rolls: Cirren Investigation advantage from Mara Help d20 faces14,13, take14 +7=21 vs predeclared DC13 success. Fenar Survival d20 natural20 +5=25 vs predeclared DC13 success. Cirren/Mara inspect troll bodies and camp; find filthy hide scraps, old animal bones, NO coins, magic items, usable equipment or other loot. Fenar confirms just two troll tracks approaching from southern drainage/game trails, no evidence of more accompanying them, nearby ambush stations or organized party; this is not a guarantee the wilderness will remain safe. No extra enemies, traps, owned item custody or money manufactured. Approx 15 minutes pass after combat on same Day266 nightfall. Fenar Rage (house up to10 minutes) and Shift (1 minute) naturally end, Cirren Spiritual Weapon (1minute) expires; no resource refund. V HP27/48, Fenar17/59, Cirren49/51 remain; no spells/psi/MP/healing/coin/food/feed spent. Mara still with four safe horses to north, coach stationary and intact. No short/long rest completed, wilderness Long Rest0/6. The group remains free to choose next action.

V chooses whether to depart, tend wounds, secure camp, rest, etc.; do not preselect or advance.
